methodology.note: GPT is a differential oracle, not ground truth. Eight source reviews were reused unchanged from earlier locked blind batches; rw-009 and rw-155 were locked before this targeted current-main scanner reveal.

summary.note: Raw HorusTrace finding count is not a precision/recall metric because several rules can represent one semantic condition.

google-adk.key_result: Strong semantic recall on explicit ADK authority; destination-scope precision and auth/runtime qualification remain the main weaknesses.

pydantic-ai.key_result: Strong on direct code execution, direct SSRF and RAG file exposure; misses dynamically configured MCP toolsets and second-order search-result destination provenance.

cases.adjudication: Source proves the model can select the GitHub owner/repository path, but fetch_iac_files always sends requests to api.github.com and performs read-only repository retrieval. HorusTrace preserves the standalone MCP servers as unbound, which is correct, but loses the fixed-provider destination predicate and upgrades the GitHub read helper to unrestricted external egress. Both NET002 findings and PATH009 therefore overstate destination authority.

alignments.rationale: Current scanner now composes ingress -> orchestrator -> specialist -> persistent write, closing the earlier path-composition miss, but it does not preserve the specific public-default condition MEMORY_API_KEYS empty / unauthenticated endpoint.
Persistent data-write authority without an explicit approval/control boundary is represented.

Declared state-changing ADK authority is detected, but the finding layer does not qualify the pinned source import/module blockers that prevent treating the declared authority as source-proven runnable.
PATH010 reconstructs the model-selected local-file read through the ADK tool into Google Document AI; DATA001 separately identifies the broad file resource scope.

cases.adjudication: The model-callable briefing authority remains scoped and the network destination is fixed; scheduler/delivery authority is application-only. HorusTrace correctly stays quiet.

alignments.rationale: Source explicitly builds MCPServerStdio/MCPServerStreamableHTTP from local configuration and passes the resulting servers as Pydantic AI toolsets to Router and specialist agents. HorusTrace reports zero MCP servers/references for the repository and no equivalent dynamic-MCP authority claim.

scanner_observations: HorusTrace emits 23 findings: 20 runtime-source and 3 test-source. Test findings are correctly source-context tagged rather than silently counted as runtime.

Native codebase_shell really does call subprocess with model-selected allowlisted command/args, so process execution is not invented; however the command allowlist/injection controls are not reflected in the severity claim.
Several generic data-write/destructive findings represent .shotgun-scoped artifact or internal plan-state mutation and lose the source-visible confinement/control semantics.
All findings use the generic principal name 'agent', and AGT040/CAP005 duplicate more specific capabilities, producing substantial semantic noise.

alignments.rationale: Three concrete compile/exec flows are reconstructed at critical severity. Runtime initialization remains separately unqualified.
Outbound authority is recognized, but the specific model-selected URL -> WebBaseLoader flow is not reconstructed and severity is reduced to medium.
Model-callable write authority is detected, but the model-controlled filename/path scope is not represented precisely.

path_adjudication.note: The three HorusTrace paths are concrete code-execution variants; they semantically cover the two GPT code-execution chains, while the GPT model-selected URL chain remains absent.

alignments.rationale: Model-selected research terms influence DuckDuckGo results whose href values are passed to requests.get without an allowlist. The model does not directly supply the URL, but this second-order destination provenance is still broader than a fixed provider endpoint. HorusTrace emits no network finding.
HorusTrace reconstructs authenticated/user-influenced URL input through the Pydantic agent to the dynamic httpx destination.
HorusTrace reconstructs the user-selected server directory -> recursive ingestion -> RAG -> model retrieval/content exposure chain.

next_build_order: P0 Pydantic AI: detect dynamically constructed MCPServerStdio/MCPServerStreamableHTTP values passed through toolsets, preserving configuration-dependent catalogue/approval state.
P0 ADK/network precision: propagate fixed-provider destination evidence through FunctionTool helpers and delegation so api.github.com reads do not become unrestricted egress or PATH009.
P1 network dataflow: support second-order search-result-derived destination provenance without conflating it with direct arbitrary-URL authority.
P1 runtime viability: preserve import/initialization blockers as a separate qualification on declared authority and paths.
P1 Pydantic precision: preserve native tool resource scope/internal-state semantics and reduce generic AGT040/CAP005 duplication/generic 'agent' attribution.
P1 ingress semantics: carry concrete authentication/public-mode predicates into composed attack paths.
